body.statement: Plan a mission from receipt through approval, using the joint planning process.
body.areaOfResponsibility: The command's assigned area of responsibility
body.standingGuidance: Apply the joint planning process. Develop more than one course of action, keep assumptions explicit, and wait for approval before treating one course as the decision.
body.evidenceStandard: Cite supplied evidence for every claim. Mark insufficient evidence explicitly.
knownConstraints: Every mission inherits this staff, standing guidance, evidence standard, and area of responsibility
